```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)
library(lubridate)

# This report is rendered from within 1_in-survey_summaries.r.
# rmarkdown::render() is called with envir = environment() from that script, so every object
# referenced below already exists -- nothing here re-reads or re-derives
# any data. All tables and maps are shown exactly as the script produces
# them (cumulative across the whole survey to date), with no per-day filtering.
```

```{r helpers}
# Render a table
show_table <- function(df, caption = NULL, align = NULL, bold_rows = NULL) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    knitr::asis_output("*No data available.*")
  } else {
    tbl <- knitr::kable(df, digits = 2, caption = caption, row.names = FALSE, align = align) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
    if (!is.null(bold_rows)) {
      tbl <- tbl |> kableExtra::row_spec(bold_rows, bold = TRUE)
    }
    tbl
  }
}
```

```{r disclaimer-block}
knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  '<p style="color: darkred;">',
  "<strong>Important:</strong> this is a preliminary, within-survey summary report. ",
  "The data still need to be thoroughly error-checked. This report is for internal use ",
  "and covers the marine mammal component of the survey only.",
  "</p>"
))
```

```{r survey-info}
survey_start <- as.Date("2026-09-11")
survey_end   <- as.Date("2026-09-29")

vessel_name <- gps_effort1 |>
  filter(!is.na(Vessel)) |>
  pull(Vessel) |>
  first()

all_dates  <- c(gps_effort1$date_adt, effort2$date_adt)
first_date <- max(suppressWarnings(min(all_dates, na.rm = TRUE)), survey_start)
last_date  <- suppressWarnings(max(all_dates, na.rm = TRUE))

date_range_label <- if (format(first_date, "%Y-%m") == format(last_date, "%Y-%m")) {
  paste0(format(first_date, "%B %d"), " to ", format(last_date, "%d, %Y"))
} else {
  paste0(format(first_date, "%B %d, %Y"), " to ", format(last_date, "%B %d, %Y"))
}
```

```{r survey-info-block}
knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "**Survey:** ", dataset, "  \n",
  "**Vessel:** ", vessel_name, "  \n",
  "**Data range covered:** ", date_range_label, "  \n"
))
```


```{r survey-progress}
report_ref_date <- if (is.na(params$report_date)) Sys.Date() else as.Date(params$report_date)

survey_total_days       <- as.numeric(survey_end - survey_start) + 1
survey_days_range_label <- paste0("Sept ", format(survey_start, "%d"), " to ", format(survey_end, "%d"))

days_completed <- min(max(as.numeric(report_ref_date - survey_start) + 1, 0), survey_total_days)
days_remaining <- survey_total_days - days_completed

pct_completed_days <- scales::percent(days_completed / survey_total_days, accuracy = 1)
pct_remaining_days <- scales::percent(days_remaining / survey_total_days, accuracy = 1)

pct_transects_completed <- table2b_total$Prop_completed
pct_transects_label     <- scales::percent(pct_transects_completed, accuracy = 1)

# MANUAL: update these values (days) as needed
time_lost_manual <- c(
  "SAR tasking"   = 2.3,
  "Vessel repair" = 2.25,
  "Crew change"   = 0.2
)

# Bad weather is calculated in 1_in-survey_summaries.R
time_lost <- c(time_lost_manual,
               "Bad weather (BFT ≥ 6 or vis < 500m)" = weather_lost_days-2) # minus 2 because those are captured by the SAR

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "## Overall Survey Progress\n\n",
  "**Number of planned survey days:** ", survey_total_days, " (", survey_days_range_label, ")  \n",
  "**Number of completed survey days:** ", days_completed, " (", pct_completed_days, ")  \n",
  "**Number of remaining survey days:** ", days_remaining, " (", pct_remaining_days, ")  \n",
  "**Number of planned transects:** ", n_transects_planned, "  \n",
  "**Number of completed transects (across all effort states):** ", n_transects_completed_any, "  \n",
  "**Survey time lost:**\n\n",
  paste0("* ", names(time_lost), ": ", round(time_lost, 1), " d", collapse = "\n"),
  "\n* **Total: ", round(sum(time_lost), 1), " d**\n\n"
))

```



# Effort Summary

<!-- ## Distance & Hours by Effort Status


**Effort status definitions:**

**ON**

- On transect
- 2 or 3 (if using Big Eyes) observers outside
- Consistent scanning effort
- Straight course and ~10 kts (>5 kts)
- Weather within limits (sea state < 6, visibility > 500m)

**BRIDGE-ON**

- On transect
- 2 observers inside bridge
- Consistent scanning effort
- Straight course and ~10 kts (>5 kts)
- Weather within limits

**TRANSIT-ON**

- Not on transect
- 2 observers inside or outside
- Consistent scanning effort
- Straight course and ~10 kts (>5 kts)
- Weather within limits

**OFF**

- Sea state > 5
- Visibility < 500 m

-->

```{r table1, include=FALSE}
show_table(
  table1,
  caption = "Table 1. Distance (km) and hours (h) spent in each effort status, by date.",
  align = "c"
)

```

<!-- ## Proportion of Planned Transects Completed -->


```{r table2a}
table2a_display <- table2a |>
  mutate(Realized_km   = round(Realized_km, 1),
         Planned_km    = round(Planned_km, 1),
         `% Completed` = scales::percent(Prop_completed, accuracy = 1)) |>
  select(Date_adt, Transect_ID, Planned_km, Realized_km, `% Completed`)

show_table(
  table2a_display,
  caption = paste0(
    "Table 1. Proportion of transects completed during ",
    "\"On\" or \"Bridge-On\" effort, by date and Transect ID."
  )
)
```

<!-- ## Cumulative Coverage by Strata -->

```{r table2b}
table2b_display <- bind_rows(
  table2b_strata,
  table2b_total |> mutate(Strata = "Overall") |> relocate(Strata)
) |>
  mutate(Realized_km   = round(Realized_km, 1),
         Planned_km    = round(Planned_km, 1),
         `% Completed` = scales::percent(Prop_completed, accuracy = 1)) |>
  select(Strata, Planned_km, Realized_km, `% Completed`)

show_table(
  table2b_display,
  caption = paste0(
    "Table 2. Cumulative planned vs. realized transect coverage ",
    "during \"On\" or \"Bridge-On\" effort, by strata and overall."
  )
)
```

## Environmental Conditions

```{r table4a}
table4a_display <- table4a |>
  mutate(`% of time` = scales::percent(Prop_time, accuracy = 1)) |>
  select(`Sea state (BFT)` = Sea_state_BFT,
         `Hours` = Duration_h,
         `% of time`)

show_table(
  table4a_display,
  caption = "Table 3. Hours and proportion of survey time spent in each sea state (Beaufort), summed across all survey days.",
  align = "c"
)
```

```{r table4b}
table4b_display <- table4b |>
  mutate(`% of time` = scales::percent(Prop_time, accuracy = 1)) |>
  select(`Visibility` = Visibility,
         `Hours` = Duration_h,
         `% of time`)

show_table(
  table4b_display,
  caption = "Table 4. Hours and proportion of survey time spent in each visibility category (worst of port and starboard), summed across all survey days.",
  align = "c"
)
```
